{"consolidated_memory":"FLAKY CI PIPELINE JOB IN build/ci/pipeline.yml - SIX SEPARATE FIXES

Component: build/ci/pipeline.yml (build system)
Persistent signal: one job failing on a minority of runs (flaky)
Stack: YAML
Covering check: pipeline replay job
Repro method (consistent across all): rerun the same commit ten times
Context: All incidents in same corner of build/ci/pipeline.yml with context carrying over

---

OCCASION 1: [2026-01-06]
Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query
PR: #1399, branch: fix/flaky-job-1
Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 81 days running

OCCASION 2: [2026-02-26]
Trigger: first request after cold start
Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
Fix: moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
PR: #2465, branch: fix/flaky-job-2
Result: cold start dropped 50 percent, to 91 ms

OCCASION 3: [2026-04-02]
Trigger: clients still pinned to v1 SDK
Root cause: error swallowed by bare except
Fix: narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate
PR: #3428, branch: fix/flaky-job-3
Result: error rate dropped from 8.9 percent to under 1 per ten thousand

OCCASION 4: [2026-04-08]
Trigger: after rolling restart of the fleet
Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
PR: #8248, branch: fix/flaky-job-4
Result: memory settled at 942 MB instead of climbing past 7 GB

OCCASION 5: [2026-05-17]
Trigger: accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
Fix: added the composite index and backfilled in batches
PR: #9011, branch: fix/flaky-job-5
Result: flaky test went from 60 failures per hundred runs to zero

OCCASION 6: [2026-05-23]
Trigger: sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
PR: #9341, branch: fix/flaky-job-6
Result: p99 latency fell from 1.2 s to 326 ms"}
